about: Half-Life 2 is the physics-shooter that taught a generation what in-engine physics meant: the gravity gun turns props into weapons and puzzles, city 17's occupied streets carry the Combine's occupation with barely a cutscene, and the vehicle chapters stretch the same engine grammar across coast and highway. Its storytelling-through-design remains the series' core law.

Valve shipped it in november 2004, and the steam listing is the current official door at a token price - the original build with the episodes attached in the package structure. It is the studio's own platform, so the route is as official as pc gaming gets.
Source engine 2004 is trivially under the haswell igpu bar at native settings. Not-tested stands until a run confirms install, launch and saves end to end.
